language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon initially lies on the table (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its fingers around the handle and lifts the spoon clear of the table (frames 98–120, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then carries it to the open drawer. At frames 225–231, wrist_image shows the fingers opening and the spoon descending into the drawer; by frames 232–236 it remains inside, separate from the gripper. No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or other side effect is visible.
